workarounds.symptom: Gmail threads feed: one undecodable message poisons the whole sync (no quarantine, checkpoint never advances)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(gmail): quarantine undecodable threads (#3680). Target files: packages/connectors/src/google_gmail.ts, packages/connectors/src/__tests__/google_gmail.test.ts. One permanently undecodable message poisoned the whole Gmail threads feed sync: the run rejected, zero threads synced, the checkpoint never advanced, and the feed re-failed identically on every retry with no quarantine and no offending-message identity. Production feed 445 was dead since 2026-09-11. . (Ref: https://github.com/lobu-ai/lobu/pull/3682)

workarounds.symptom: bug(review): make review fails on macOS because review-cache requires sha256sum
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(review): support macOS sha256 hashing. Target files: scripts/lib/__tests__/review-cache.test.sh, scripts/lib/review-cache.sh. Review-cache hashing uses `sha256sum` when available and otherwise `shasum -a 256`. The native shasum test now runs only when that executable is installed. Controlled executable fixtures always check primary-only, fallback-only, and both-backend selection, including primary preference when the fallback directory comes first in PATH. (Ref: https://github.com/lobu-ai/lobu/pull/3675)

workarounds.symptom: AGENTS.md documents a "rest" platform that apply rejects ("Unsupported platform: rest")
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(server): accept rest as a first-class adapterless platform. Target files: packages/server/src/gateway/connections/chat-instance-manager.ts, packages/server/src/gateway/connections/types.ts, packages/server/src/lobu/__tests__/agent-routes-rest-platform.test.ts. The scaffolded AGENTS.md documents a `rest` platform binding (`{ type: "rest", config: {} }` — "HTTP API — always config: {}") and `lobu validate` accepts it, but apply fails server-side (confirmed e2e on published CLI 11.0.0): (Ref: https://github.com/lobu-ai/lobu/pull/1212)
